test_title: PYST 38: SSC CHSL - English (Held On: 26 May 2022 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in active voice.**

The new bride is going to be admired by everyone in the family.

options.text: Everybody in the family is going to admire the new bride.
Everybody in the family was admiring the new bride.
Everybody in the family has been going to admire the new bride.
Everybody in the family was going to admire the new bride.

solution:
The correct answer is **Everybody in the family is going to admire the new bride.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

 
• The given sentence is in **Future (going to)** tense.
 
• The structure of this tense in active and passive forms is as follows:
 
 
• **Active voice:** Subject + is/am/are going to + V1 + Object.
 
• **Passive voice:** Object + is/am/are going to + be + V3 + by + Subject.
 
 
 
• **Example**:
 
 
• **Active voice: **I am going to do that work.
 
• **Passive voice:** That work is going to be done by me.
 
 

Hence, the correct option is **Option 1**.
